response.sql: SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total_points, AVG(avg_laps) AS avg_of_avg_laps FROM (SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS total_points, AVG(CAST(laps AS REAL)) AS avg_laps FROM results WHERE grid > 12 GROUP BY driverId) AS per_driver

assumptions.assumption: 'Starting grid position higher than 12' is read as the numeric value grid > 12 (i.e., starting 13th or further back), not as a better position. Grid 0 (pit lane/no grid slot) is excluded since 0 is not > 12.
laps is stored as TEXT, so it is cast to REAL for averaging; NULL values are ignored by SUM and AVG. Drivers are grouped by driverId, and each driver is weighted equally in the final averages.
